subject: sessionctx/variable: set DEFAULT_VALUE for 'tidb_txn_mode' (#48500)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for session/sessionctx changes. `tidb_txn_mode` now has a concrete default (`DefTiDBTxnMode = "pessimistic"`) so DEFAULT_VALUE is no longer empty (`pkg/sessionctx/variable/tidb_vars.go:1226`, `pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go:1911`). A bootstrap upgrade inserts missing `mysql.global_variables.tidb_txn_mode=optimistic` to preserve legacy behavior for clusters that previously relied on an unset/empty value mapping to optimistic (`pkg/session/bootstrap.go:2956`), consistent with txn-mode handling where empty selects optimistic (`pkg/session/txnmanager.go:340`, `pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go:2586`). Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: this behavior is retained (refactored but not reverted/fixed).
